workflow.name: rerank_topk
workflow.description: 通用重排子工作流：输入 items(数组)+scores(number数组)+k → zip 降序排序取 topk。输出 topk(数组)/indices(原下标数组)。供检索/精排类工作流复用（subworkflow 节点调用）

node.title: rerank
node.code: async def main(args): p = args.params items = p.get("items") or [] scores = p.get("scores") or [] try: k = max(0, int(p.get("k") or 3)) except (TypeError, ValueError): k = 3 # 对齐长度（防御：LLM 批处理可能丢一两个分数） n = min(len(items), len(scores)) pairs = [] for i in range(n): try: s = float(scores[i]) except (TypeError, ValueError): s = 0.0 pairs.append((s, i, items[i])) pairs.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0]) topk = [it for _, _, it in pairs[:k]] idx = [i for _, i, _ in pairs[:k]] return {"topk": topk, "indices": idx, "scores_topk": [s for s, _, _ in pairs[:k]]}
